# Game Board 12 / Season 12: Preview for "One More Time" Emote & RIP Daring Jetpack (Secret Service Armor & Brotherhood Recon Armor)

In the current season there is another new emote and, for the first time, an alternative jetpack for the Secret Service armor and the Brotherhood reconnaissance armor.

See also: All Season 12 Rewards: RIP Daring on the Cryptid Hunt (Board 12)

## RIP Daring Jetpack / Reckless Jetpack (Secret Service Armor & Brotherhood Recon Armor)

The jetpack must be **recrafted** on your Secret Service Armor or Brotherhood Reconnaissance Armor as skins cannot be applied to mods. So you need a few more fluxes for this.
